name: Visual Evidence Readback
description: Bounded PNG readback receipts, reference/model comparisons, and explicit visual-review attestations. No network, shell, image generation or model calls.

tools.name: image_prepare
tools.description: Prepare a bounded PNG derivative of one existing allowlisted project image. Returns preview_path and SHA-256 receipt. Read preview_path with native DevSpace read to see pixels; metadata alone is not a visual pass.

tools.name: image_compare
tools.description: Create a readback-sized source/model comparison without warping or rendering new artwork. Registered overlay requires identical source pixel canvases and an explicit camera/registration note.

tools.name: image_review_record
tools.description: Record explicit agent visual observations only AFTER actual native image read. Verifies preview and original hashes, rejecting stale images. Cannot certify human aesthetics automatically.
